marca.titulo: Issue electronic receipts without the hassle.
marca.subtitulo: Invoices, credit and debit notes, and voided document notices, in UBL 2.1 and with SUNAT validation rules.

login.subtitulo: Sign in to your account to continue.
login.soloPorInvitacion: Access is by invitation while the beta lasts.

registro.ayudaTelefono: We will contact you if there is any problem with your account. 9 digits, starting with 9.
registro.ayudaPassword: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
registro.terminosRequeridos: To create your account you must accept the terms of service and the privacy policy.

recuperar.subtitulo: We will send you a link to reset it.
recuperar.confirmacion: If the email is registered, we sent you a link to reset your password.

restablecer.subtitulo: Enter your new password to continue.
restablecer.ayudaPassword: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
restablecer.exito: Your password was updated. You can now sign in.

invitacion.subtitulo: We signed you up for khipu. Choose the password you will use to sign in.
invitacion.ayudaPassword: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
invitacion.exito: Your password is ready. You can now sign in.
invitacion.enlaceInvalido: The invitation link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one from “Forgot your password?” on the sign-in page.

verificar.subtitulo: Confirm that this email is yours to start issuing.
verificar.exito: Your email is verified. You can now set up your company and start issuing.
verificar.enlaceInvalido: The verification link is invalid, has expired, or was already used. Sign in and request another.

aceptarInvitacion.subtitulo: Create your password to sign in.
aceptarInvitacion.ayudaPassword: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
aceptarInvitacion.exito: Done: you are now part of the team. Sign in with your email and the password you chose.
aceptarInvitacion.enlaceInvalido: The invitation link is invalid, has expired, or was already used. Ask the person who invited you to resend it.

revisaTuCorreo.descripcion: We sent a link to {email} to verify that it is yours. Open it to set up your company and start issuing: until then you can look around the portal, but you cannot create or issue anything.
revisaTuCorreo.reenviado: We sent you another link. Check your spam folder too.

segundoFactor.verificarDescripcion: Open your authenticator app and enter the code it shows for khipu.
segundoFactor.verificarRecuperacionDescripcion: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved. Each one works only once.
segundoFactor.configurarDescripcion: The backoffice can see the tax data of all customers, so to sign in you need, in addition to your password, a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…).
segundoFactor.configurarPaso1: Scan this QR code with the app.
segundoFactor.configurarSecreto: Can’t scan it? Enter this key in the app:
segundoFactor.configurarPaso2: Enter the 6-digit code shown by the app.
segundoFactor.configurarQrAlt: QR code to add khipu to your authenticator app
segundoFactor.codigosDescripcion: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. They are not shown again: copy or print them and keep them somewhere other than your phone.

inicio.descripcion: Everything managed on the platform, grouped the same way as the menu.

resumen.cuentas: Registered customers: sign-up, plan, payments, status, and user access.
resumen.empresas: Every RUC on the platform: environment, certificate, SOL credentials, and API keys.
resumen.planes: What you sell: price and limits of each plan.
resumen.consumo: How much each account used this month against its plan cap.
resumen.monitor: How issuing is going over the last 24 hours and whether SUNAT is responding.
resumen.errores: Documents with problems across all customers, from most to least urgent.
resumen.avisos: Certificates about to expire and rejected SOL credentials, so you can warn customers in time.
resumen.integridad: Checks that the stored XML and CDR files are still the signed ones.
resumen.configuracion: Sender, email templates, and maintenance notice.

cuentas.buscar: Search by email, name, RUC or business name
cuentas.error: Could not load the list of accounts.

empresas.descripcion: All companies on the platform and whether they are able to issue.
empresas.buscar: Search by RUC or business name

columnas.delMesAyuda: All documents issued this month, accepted or not. What counts toward the plan (what SUNAT accepted, even if later voided) is under Usage.

empresas.error: Could not load the list of companies.

planes.descripcion: What is sold: the price and limits of each plan, and how many accounts have it. Changing a limit applies to the next cycle (the calendar month in Lima), not the one in progress.
planes.error: Could not load the list of plans.
planes.porDefectoAyuda: This is the plan every new account starts with: it cannot be deactivated or deleted.
planes.noPublicadoAyuda: Custom plan: it can be assigned and billed, but it does not appear on the pricing page.
planes.programadoAyuda: This limit change is not in effect yet: it starts at the beginning of the next cycle.

formulario.descripcionNuevo: It starts active and can be assigned to accounts right away.
formulario.descripcionEditar: Change the plan name, price or limits.
efectosNuevo: The plan is offered from the moment you create it.
The name cannot be repeated, regardless of capitalization.
efectosEditar: The name and price change immediately.
The new limits take effect on {fecha}, at the start of the next cycle: raising or lowering a limit mid-month does not change this month and does not cut anyone off.
Accounts that already have the plan are not affected.
formulario.hayProgramado: You are seeing the limits already scheduled (from {fecha}). If you set today’s limits again, the change is canceled.
formulario.precioAyuda: In soles, with up to two decimals. Zero for a free plan.
formulario.visible: Show it on the pricing page
formulario.visibleAyuda: Uncheck it for a custom plan for one customer: it is assigned and billed all the same, but not published.

errores.nombreLargo: The name can be up to 40 characters.
errores.precioInvalido: Enter a price of zero or more (up to 99,999,999.99), with up to two decimals.
errores.limiteInvalido: Enter a whole number greater than zero, or check “Unlimited”.
errores.numeroInvalido: Enter a whole number greater than zero.

desactivar.descripcion: Takes it off the market without affecting those who already have it.
efectos: It stops being offered: it can no longer be assigned to new accounts.
It can be offered again whenever you want.
desactivar.cuentasUna: The account that has it keeps it: its subscription does not change.
desactivar.cuentasVarias: The {n} accounts that have it keep it: their subscriptions do not change.

activar.descripcion: Puts it back on the market.
efectos: It can be assigned to accounts again.
It does not change the accounts that already have it.

eliminar.descripcion: Only a plan that no one has ever used can be deleted.
efectos: The plan is deleted forever, along with its scheduled limit change if it has one.
If any account has ever had it, it cannot be deleted: it has to be deactivated.

consumo.descripcion: How much each account used during the month against the cap of its current plan, to warn before it hits the limit or runs out of service. It counts what SUNAT accepted, even if it was later voided, by issue date, in the Lima calendar month.
consumo.ayudaPlanDeHoy: Compared against each account’s current plan, even for a past month.
consumo.ayudaAlerta: Near the limit: from {umbral} % of the monthly document cap.

vacio.CERCA_DEL_LIMITE: No account is near its limit this month.
vacio.PLAN_VENCIDO: No account has an expired plan.

consumo.error: Could not load the accounts’ usage.

planDeCuenta.error: Could not load the account plan.
planDeCuenta.cubreHasta: Service continues until {fecha}, grace period included.
planDeCuenta.programado: Moves to {plan} on {fecha}, at the start of the next cycle. Until then it stays on {actual}.

dialogo.descripcion: Upgrades take effect now; downgrades, at the start of the next cycle.
dialogo.pagadoHastaAyuda: Required on a paid plan. A free plan does not expire.
dialogo.graciaAyuda: How long service continues after expiration: 0 to 90 days.
dialogo.errorPrevia: Could not calculate what would happen.
dialogo.efectoCicloSiguiente: Takes effect on {fecha}, at the start of the next cycle. Until then the account stays on {actual}.
dialogo.consumo: In {mes} the account used {n} documents (this counts what SUNAT accepted, even if later voided). The {plan} plan allows {limite} per month.
dialogo.consumoSinTope: In {mes} the account used {n} documents (this counts what SUNAT accepted, even if later voided). The {plan} plan has no document cap.
dialogo.superaInmediato: It already exceeds that cap: with an immediate change, the account would be over its limit for this month.
dialogo.superaBajada: Nothing changes this month: until the next cycle the account stays on its current plan.
dialogo.descartaInmediato: Cancels the move to {plan} scheduled for {fecha}: the account stays on the new plan.
dialogo.descartaBajada: Replaces the move to {plan} scheduled for {fecha}.

errores.vencimientoRequerido: A paid plan needs the date through which it is paid.
errores.vencimientoPasado: The date must be today or later.

pagos.descripcion: This account’s payments that were recorded by hand. There is no automatic charging: this is the trail of what the customer paid.
pagos.vacio: No payment has been recorded yet.
pagos.error: Could not load the account’s payments.

dialogo.descripcion: Record what the customer has already paid. It goes into the history and the audit log; it does not charge anything.
dialogo.montoAyuda: In soles, with up to two decimals.
dialogo.referenciaAyuda: Operation number. With a reference, the same method with the same reference cannot be recorded twice.
dialogo.extender: Extend the plan expiration to the end of the period
dialogo.extenderHoy: Today it is paid through {actual}; it would move to {nuevo}.
dialogo.extenderNoVence: This account’s plan does not expire: there is no expiration to extend.
dialogo.extenderNoAdelanta: The account is already paid through {actual}: this period does not move the expiration forward.
dialogo.extenderSinPlan: The account’s plan could not be loaded, so the expiration cannot be extended from here.
dialogo.extenderElegirPeriodo: Choose the end of the period to see the new expiration.

errores.desdeRequerido: Enter the date the payment starts covering.
errores.hastaRequerido: Enter the date the payment covers through.
errores.periodoAlReves: The period cannot end before it starts.
errores.periodoLargo: The period cannot exceed one year.
errores.montoInvalido: The amount must be greater than zero, with up to two decimals.
errores.fechaFutura: The payment date cannot be in the future.
errores.extenderSinEfecto: This period does not move the expiration forward: uncheck the extension or fix the period.

integridad.descripcion: Checks that the stored XML and CDR files are still the ones that were signed. Read-only: it repairs nothing. The same sweep runs daily over the last few days.
integridad.ayudaRango: By issue date, up to {max} days at a time.
integridad.avisoVerificando: Checking the documents in the range. It can take a while if there are many; do not close the page.

resultado.verificadosNinguno: There were no signed documents between {desde} and {hasta}.

tiposAyuda.XML_FALTANTE: The document is signed but its XML is no longer in storage.
tiposAyuda.XML_CORRUPTO: The XML exists but does not contain the DigestValue it was signed with, or it is truncated.
tiposAyuda.CDR_FALTANTE: SUNAT responded but its CDR is no longer in storage.
tiposAyuda.STORAGE_INACCESIBLE: Storage could not be read: it may be a connection failure rather than a lost object. It is worth running the check again.

errores.desdeRequerido: Enter the start of the range to verify.
errores.hastaRequerido: Enter the end of the range to verify.
errores.alReves: The range cannot end before it starts.

monitor.descripcion: How issuance is going for all customers: the documents from the last 24 hours, the SUNAT submission queue, and whether SUNAT is responding. It refreshes on its own every 30 seconds.
monitor.errorAlActualizar: Could not refresh the monitor. Showing the last reading.
monitor.sesionTerminada: Your session ended. Reload the page to sign in again.

alerta.uno: There is 1 overdue submission and it has been waiting {tiempo}. The job that empties the queue is probably not running.
alerta.varios: There are {n} overdue submissions and the longest-waiting one has been waiting {tiempo}. The job that empties the queue is probably not running.

alertaResumenes.titulo: Some SUNAT procedures have no response
alertaResumenes.uno: 1 daily summary or voiding request has gone {tiempo} without a response from SUNAT (limit: {umbral} h).
alertaResumenes.varios: {n} daily summaries or voiding requests have gone more than {umbral} h without a response from SUNAT; the oldest, {tiempo}.
alertaResumenes.ayuda: khipu keeps asking for its ticket (every 5 minutes at most) and does not give up, so it will not resolve on its own: check the ticket in SUNAT. In the meantime the receipt or document stays submitted, accepting neither voiding nor notes.

alertaBoletas.titulo: Some receipts have not been reported to SUNAT
alertaBoletas.uno: 1 receipt has gone 5 days or more without being reported; the oldest was issued on {fecha}.
alertaBoletas.varios: {n} receipts have gone 5 days or more without being reported; the oldest was issued on {fecha}.
alertaBoletas.urgente: 1 is on day 7 or already past it.
alertaBoletas.urgentes: {n} are on day 7 or already past it.
alertaBoletas.ayuda: Nobody else sends them: the customer left them unsent or their submission is failing. The daily summary accepts them up to day 7; after that they are reported late and SUNAT may flag them. Let the customer know.

hoy.tasaAyuda: Rejected out of those SUNAT has already resolved.

categoriasAyuda.aceptados: Accepted by SUNAT, with or without observations.
categoriasAyuda.conError: Did not arrive: submission error or past the deadline.
categoriasAyuda.enCamino: Signed, submitted, or waiting for the daily summary.

horas.ayuda: Documents created per hour, in Lima time.
horas.sinDatos: No document was created in the last 24 hours.
horas.grafico: Documents created per hour in the last 24 hours

outbox.ayuda: Submissions to SUNAT waiting to go out. A scheduled retry does not count as overdue.
outbox.masAntiguo: The oldest has been waiting since
outbox.vencidoHace: The longest-waiting one has been waiting {tiempo}.

sunat.ayuda: Whether each service responds. The reading is cached for 30 seconds and does not submit any document.

errores.descripcion: Problem documents from all customers, from most to least urgent: sending error, format error, past deadline and unsent receipt, with the SUNAT fault and the attempts. Only a sending error can be retried or discarded; the others are already terminal or are up to the customer.

ayudaClase.ERROR_DE_ENVIO: SUNAT did not respond or failed. It retries on its own.
ayudaClase.ERROR_DE_FORMATO: SUNAT rejected it with a fault 1000–1999: retrying will not change that.
ayudaClase.FUERA_DE_PLAZO: It did not arrive within the sending deadline: it has to be issued again.
ayudaClase.BOLETA_SIN_ENVIAR: A receipt the customer left unsent that is already 5 days old or more. Nothing failed, but the daily summary closes on day 7: let them know.

errores.decisionDelCliente: Sending it is the customer’s decision: let them know

vacio.TODAS: There are no problem documents. All clear.
vacio.FUERA_DE_PLAZO: There are no documents past the deadline.

errores.vacioConBusqueda: No problem document matches the search.
errores.error: Could not load the error queue.

efectos: Sends the document to SUNAT now, with its company’s credentials.
If SUNAT fails again, it stays as a sending error and keeps retrying on its own.
If it is no longer pending or the deadline has passed, it is not sent and you are notified.
It is recorded in the audit log.

descarte.efectoConsultaSunat: In production, SUNAT is asked first whether it already received it: if it has it, its response is applied and the document is not discarded.
descarte.efectoSinConsultaSunat: SUNAT does not allow looking up receipts or receipt notes by series and number: it cannot be asked whether it already received this one. If the submission was cut off after SUNAT accepted it, discarding it leaves two receipts for the same sale; when in doubt, retry the submission.
efectos: The document is discarded: it is never sent again, neither automatically nor manually. This cannot be undone.
The customer has to issue a new one; this one’s number stays consumed.
It is removed from the sending queue and from this list.
It is recorded in the audit log with your reason.
descarte.ayudaMotivo: Required. It is recorded in the audit log. Up to {max} characters.

avisos.descripcion: Companies that need to be warned about something before they can no longer issue: an expiring or expired certificate, and SOL credentials that SUNAT does not accept. The notice is emailed to the account; the same notice is not repeated within a week.
avisos.sinCertificado: Companies that never uploaded their certificate also cannot issue, but they have nothing to expire and do not appear here.

ayuda.CERTIFICADOS: Certificates that expire in less than 30 days or have already expired, from most to least urgent.
ayuda.CREDENCIALES_SOL: Inferred from submissions that are failing now: a company that is not issuing does not appear, and one that has already resubmitted successfully drops off on its own.

avisos.sinCuenta: No account: there is no one to notify

vacio.CERTIFICADOS: No certificate expires in the next 30 days. All good.
vacio.CREDENCIALES_SOL: No company has submissions stuck because of its SOL credentials.

avisos.error: Could not load the list of notices.

efectos: Sends an email to {correo}: {que}.
The same notice is not repeated within a week, even if another administrator clicks at the same time.
It is recorded in the audit log, without the customer’s email.

que.CERTIFICADO_POR_VENCER: that their digital certificate is about to expire
que.CERTIFICADO_VENCIDO: that their digital certificate has expired and they cannot issue
que.CREDENCIALES_SOL_INVALIDAS: that SUNAT does not accept their SOL credentials

configuracion.descripcion: What changes what customers see and receive, without waiting for a deployment. Every change is recorded in the audit log.

correo.ayuda: Takes effect from the next email, with no restart. The mail server (SMTP) must accept sending from that address (verified sender, SPF and DKIM): this cannot be checked from here.
correo.nombreAyuda: Optional. How the sender appears in the customer’s inbox.
correo.responderAyuda: Optional. If left empty, replies go back to the sender.
correo.delServidor: This is the one from the server configuration: nobody has changed it from here.
correo.guardado: Sender saved: it takes effect from the next email.

restablecer.descripcion: Emails go back to being sent from the sender in the server configuration.
efectos: Removes the sender set here, and emails go back to being sent from {remitente}.
Takes effect from the next email. It does not change the email texts.
It is recorded in the audit log.

plantillas.ayuda: The text of each email the platform sends. Anything not changed goes out with the default text. Takes effect from the next email.
plantillas.variablesAyuda: They are written between braces and replaced when the email is sent. Click to insert one where the cursor is.
plantillas.vistaPreviaTitulo: This is how it would look, with sample values
plantillas.guardado: Text saved: it takes effect from the next email.
plantillas.deFabrica: It goes out with the default text.

restaurar.descripcion: The email “{correo}” goes back to being sent with its default text.
efectos: Deletes the text written here: it cannot be undone, but it can be written again.
Takes effect from the next email.
It is recorded in the audit log (without the text).

aviso.ayuda: A notice that all customers see at the top of their portal, also before signing in. It always has an end: it hides itself. Times are Lima time.
aviso.textoAyuda: A single line, up to {max} characters. It is shown as plain text.
aviso.hastaAyuda: Required, and at most {dias} days after it starts.
aviso.retirado: Notice withdrawn: it is no longer shown to anyone.
aviso.vistaPrevia: This is how customers will see it

estado.vencido: It has already expired: not shown.

retirar.descripcion: It stops being shown to customers right now.
efectos: Customers stop seeing the notice as soon as they reload their portal.
To show it again, it has to be published again.
It is recorded in the audit log.

darDeBaja.descripcion: {nombre} is removed from the lists and from billing. Nothing is deleted and it can be reversed.
efectos: The account and its companies stop appearing in the lists unless you ask to see them.
Documents, XML and CDR are kept, and its RUC stays taken: no one else will be able to register it.
It does not cut off access: its users can still sign in and its API keys can still issue. To cut off service, suspend the account.
Restoring the account brings it back to the lists.
darDeBaja.motivoAyuda: It is recorded in the audit log. Up to 200 characters; never write passwords or API keys.

reponer.descripcion: {nombre} returns to the lists and to billing.
efectos: The account and its companies appear in the lists again.
Nothing else changes: if it was suspended, it stays suspended until you reactivate it.

suspender.descripcion: This cuts off service for {nombre} right now. Nothing is deleted and it can be reversed.
efectos: None of its users will be able to sign in to the portal, even with a session already open.
None of its companies will be able to issue or query through the API: their API keys will respond “account suspended”.
Documents already issued will keep being sent to SUNAT: stopping them would put them past the deadline.
Reactivating the account restores everything as it was, with the same sessions and API keys.
suspender.motivoAyuda: Saved in the audit log. Up to 200 characters; never write passwords or API keys.

efectos: Its users can sign in to the portal again, with the sessions they already had.
Its companies can issue through the API again, with the same API keys.
From this moment it issues against SUNAT production: the documents it issues are real.
It needs the production SOL credentials and certificate: test (beta) ones will be rejected.
It does not affect documents already issued.
It cannot be changed while it has pending submissions to SUNAT: what was issued in one environment must not be sent to the other.
It is recorded in the audit log, from which environment to which.
From this moment it issues against the SUNAT test environment: the documents it issues have no validity.
It does not affect documents already issued.
It cannot be changed while it has pending submissions to SUNAT: what was issued in one environment must not be sent to the other.
It is recorded in the audit log, from which environment to which.
It stops authenticating immediately: integrations that use it will start receiving 401.
The company’s other keys keep working.
It cannot be undone: another key would have to be created.
It is recorded in the audit log with its prefix, never the key itself.

conexion.sinSol: Without SOL credentials there is nothing to test with.
conexion.nota: The test asks SUNAT about a ticket that does not exist, using the company’s SOL credentials and environment: it is read-only and sends nothing. With a ticket that does not exist, a ticket error is expected; what the test tells you is whether SUNAT responded. It is recorded in the audit log.

resultados.SIN_RESPUESTA: There was no useful response from SUNAT.

comprobanteDetalle.ayudaIntentos: Counts the submissions that failed: one that SUNAT received on the first try shows 0.
comprobanteDetalle.ayudaArchivos: It only says whether they exist: their content belongs to the customer and is downloaded from their dashboard.

bajas.ayuda: The voiding communication (RA) for an invoice or the daily summary (RC) for a receipt or a receipt note, from newest to oldest. Read-only.
bajas.motivoSoloKhipu: Kept only in khipu: the daily summary does not carry it.

fiscales.sinDomicilio: They have not declared their registered address yet.

conexion.nota: It is only known whether they are uploaded: their contents never leave the backend.

apiKeys.vacio: This company has no API keys.
apiKeys.nota: Only the prefix: the secret is never shown.

comprobantes.vacio: It has not issued any documents yet.

eventos.vacio: Recent documents have no status changes.

historial.descripcion: Every suspension, reactivation, closure, and restoration of the account, with who did it and why.
historial.vacio: The account has never changed status.

impersonar.titulo: Sign in to the portal as this user
impersonar.descripcion: You will see the portal exactly as {correo} sees it.
efectos: The session lasts 15 minutes and cannot be renewed: to keep looking, you have to sign in again.
You can only look: you cannot change anything (not the password, SOL credentials, API keys, or issue documents).
It is recorded in the audit log under your name, and the customer sees it in their support access history, without your name.
It replaces the customer session you have open in this browser.

restablecer.descripcion: A link to choose a new password is sent to {correo}.
efectos: You neither see nor set the password: the link goes only to that person.
Their current password stays valid until they use the link.
It is recorded in the account audit log.

verificar.descripcion: The link to verify their email is sent again to {correo}.
efectos: The email carries a new link; only that person can use it.
It is recorded in the account audit log.

empresas.vacio: This account has no companies yet.

eventos.vacio: No administrator has acted on this account.

acciones.ACTIVAR_PLAN: Put a plan back on sale
acciones.AVISAR_AL_CLIENTE: Customer notified about their certificate or SOL password
acciones.RESTAURAR_PLANTILLA_DE_CORREO: Restored an email to its default text

alta.descripcion: Onboard a customer: their account, their first company, and their first series. The customer receives an invitation by email and chooses their own password; you never set it.
alta.subtituloCuenta: Who uses the portal and where the invitation goes
alta.subtituloEmpresa: The one that will issue the documents
alta.subtituloSerie: The one they will use to issue their first document
alta.nombreAyuda: The person or business that signs up. This is how it appears in Accounts.
alta.emailAyuda: They sign in to the portal with this email; the invitation to create their password is sent here.
alta.serieAyuda: For example F001 for invoices or B001 for receipts (SUNAT 1001).
alta.sesionExpirada: Your administrator session expired. Sign in again.
alta.corteDeConexion: The connection dropped while onboarding. Submit again without changing anything: if the onboarding already went through, you will see the same API key, without creating another account.

resultado.descripcion: The account, the company, and the series have been created.
resultado.avisoApiKey: Hand it to the customer now: it will not be shown again. Only a hash is kept, so if it is lost they will have to revoke it and create another one from their portal.
resultado.invitacionEnviada: We sent the invitation to {email}. With that link the customer creates their password and signs in.
resultado.invitacionNoEnviada: We could not send the invitation to {email}. The onboarding is done: the customer can request a link from “Forgot your password?” on the sign-in page.

descripciones.ADMIN: Everything: issues, configures the company, series, certificate and API keys, and manages the team.
descripciones.EMISOR: Issues, views and voids receipts, and saves customers and products. Cannot change the settings or the team.
descripciones.LECTURA: View only: receipts, company, series, plan and usage. Cannot issue or configure anything.

sinPermiso.emitir: Your role (Read-only) only allows viewing: ask an account administrator for whatever you need changed.
sinPermiso.configurar: Only an account administrator can change the settings.
sinPermiso.pagina: This section is only for account administrators. Ask one for whatever you need.

equipo.descripcion: The people who sign in to your account’s portal and what each one can do. Invite by email: the link lasts 7 days and works only once.
equipo.confirmarDesactivar: Deactivate? Their sessions will be closed.
equipo.avisoApiKeys: The API keys they created remain valid: they belong to the company, not to them. If needed, revoke them in

degradarme.descripcion: You will become {rol} and lose administrator access: you will no longer be able to manage the team or the settings. To get it back, another administrator will have to give it to you.

equipo.confirmarRevocar: Revoke? The link will stop working.

invitar.subtitulo: We send them a link to create their password and sign in with the role you choose.
invitar.noSalio: The invitation was saved, but the email was not sent. Resend it from the list in a few minutes.

equipo.reenviada: We sent a new link to {email}. The previous one no longer works.
equipo.reenviadaSinCorreo: We generated a new link, but the email was not sent. Try again in a few minutes.
